response.sql: WITH acct_avg AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.district_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt FROM account a JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id), region_avg AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(aa.avg_amt) AS region_figure FROM acct_avg aa JOIN district d ON d.district_id = aa.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), overall AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) AS overall_avg FROM region_avg) SELECT r.region, r.region_figure, r.region_figure - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_average, r.region_figure / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_average FROM region_avg r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.region_figure > o.overall_avg
